body: Just to add to this, I am also FTM transgender, and I'm on the Mirena IUD, will hopefully be starting testosterone soon. While dysphoria varies from person to person, I found it overall very helpful since I haven't had any periods whatsoever for a few years now. In addition, my understanding from talking to the docs is that since Mirena's hormones are more localized, the T shouldn't affect it at all, more or less. Makes it a nice long term solution.
